payload.description:
Purpose: ensure scoring enrichment only uses DeepGram payloads explicitly supplied through item metadata or posted attachments.

Definition of Done:
- Behavior is specified without client-specific details.
- Timestamp enrichment does not derive legacy object-store keys when no DeepGram attachment is present.
- Existing explicit attachment behavior remains covered by tests.
payload.title: Disable implicit DeepGram attachment lookups
